column1: # Demo dispatch radio traffic for SpeechGenSynth batch mode; the same script SpeechGenRadioDemo plays in engine.
# out <TAB> voice blend <TAB> text <TAB> speed <TAB> gap before, in seconds (SpeechGenSynth ignores the fifth column;
# demo.sh builds the montage from it). Out paths are relative to -OutDir.
# Numbers are written as words: the English normalizer reads "430" as "four hundred thirty".
# "[pNNN]" is SpeechGen pause markup: the line is split there and NNN ms of silence goes in. Only between clauses of
# long lines: a short chunk cut off from the words after it loses vowel quality, so calls, replies and leading call
#   First contact is call and wait: "Dispatch, Echo Two." / "Echo Two, go ahead." / then the traffic.
#   Once a call is established, a follow-up is one transmission, no handshake: "Dispatch, Echo Two, medical is on scene and released us."
#   A reply to related traffic is one shot if it comes seconds later, a full call if minutes later (sim time).
#   Priority traffic: "Priority, priority, priority." / "Station with priority traffic, go ahead." / the unit names itself with its traffic.
#   Other units hold routine traffic until Dispatch releases the channel; Kilo Five's report waits for that.
#   Two seconds between transmissions leaves room for priority traffic; a priority call is answered at once.
# Cast (the male voices sit at least 25 Hz of median pitch apart; speeds near 1.0, pitch does the separating):
#   Echo Two      am_eric:0.7,am_santa:0.3      speed 1.0   highest male
#   Sierra Nine   am_onyx:0.7,bm_lewis:0.3      speed 0.95  lowest, rough

column3: Dispatch, Echo Two.
Echo Two, go ahead.
I need medical at the north gate, [p250] for a visitor with a twisted ankle.
Copy, sending medical to the north gate, [p200] for a twisted ankle.
Dispatch, Kilo Five.
Kilo Five, go ahead.
We've got a noise complaint at the loading dock. [p250] A generator running, facing the hotel.
Copy, Kilo Five. See if they'll shut it down.
Dispatch, Echo Two, medical is on scene and released us. [p250] Resuming patrol.
Copy, Echo Two.
Priority, priority, priority.
Station with priority traffic, go ahead.
Dispatch, Sierra Nine: missing person at the main entrance. [p300] Elderly man, [p200] grey coat, [p200] walking cane.
All stations, all stations, this is Dispatch. We have a missing person, [p200] last seen at the main entrance. [p300] Grey coat, [p200] walking cane. [p400] Please hold routine traffic.
Sierra Nine, Dispatch: anything else you can tell me about him?
Dispatch, Sierra Nine: his name is Walter. [p300] Last seen about ten minutes ago, [p200] heading for the parking garage.
Dispatch, Victor Three, I have eyes on possible missing person with grey coat.
Copy, Victor Three. Stay with him.
Dispatch, Victor Three.
Victor Three, go ahead.
The man is confirmed, [p200] and reunited with his family at the main entrance.
All stations, all stations, this is Dispatch. The missing person is found. [p300] Thank you all. [p400] You may resume routine traffic.
Dispatch, Kilo Five, they shut it down. [p250] We're clear, [p150] resuming patrol.
Copy, Kilo Five. Thanks for taking care of that.
